name: Japanese Core kana audio bundle
pathBase: All file paths are relative to this manifest (the bundle root).
license: CC0-1.0. Synthesized by the project with the Apache-2.0 Kokoro-82M model and voice pack; no third-party recording is included.

generator.method: Phonemes from tools/tts/kana_ipa.py, spoken at the end of a carrier phrase and cut out at the consonant closure, noise onset or energy dip (tools/tts/generate.py)

note: Each recording serves every catalogue item whose audio stem equals its id (hiragana and katakana share). A checksum proves file integrity only; pronunciation needs a listener review.
